plan.notes: Source: Agnes Scott College 2025-2026 Undergraduate Academic Catalog (official PDF), Chemistry major requirements: CHE-110/110L, 120/120L; foundations 230, 240/240L, 260, 300/lab, 370; in-depth 340/340L AND (330 or 360); in-depth lab 420 or 430; MAT-119 (or equiv); PHY-102 or PHY-202. This plan uses CHE-330, CHE-420, PHY-102 per the catalog either/or options. Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30; semester sequence from catalog prerequisites (advisor should confirm). MAT-118 is included as the documented prerequisite for MAT-119 (not itself a major requirement). Gen ed = SUMMIT 34 cr + 12 cr language + electives to 128.
